responsibility: This definition module declares the procedural wrapper around the host termios API for terminal attribute control. It belongs to the runtime terminal/tty interop layer and exports an opaque TERMIOS handle, enumerations for control characters and flag bits, constructors/destructors for termios records, speed getters/setters, tcgetattr/tcsetattr and related drain/flush/flow operations, raw-mode support, and generic GetFlag/SetFlag and GetChar/SetChar accessors used by higher-level console modules such as IO.
